title: Complete measurement information order and its computable-reference obstruction
statement: Given two finite quantum channels P,Q on a common quantum input, including measurement channels from POVMs, unrestricted complete relative-entropy comparison tests D[(P tensor id_R)(alpha)||(P tensor id_R)(beta)] >= D[(Q tensor id_R)(alpha)||(Q tensor id_R)(beta)] for EVERY finite untouched quantum reference R and EVERY joint input-state pair alpha,beta. Their reference marginals may differ. Here Umegaki D(A||B)=Tr[A(log A-log B)], with value +infinity when the support condition fails. For finite descriptions of rational-complex strictly positive POVM pairs on a common input,with variable input dimension and outcome counts,complete SLD dominance is coRE-complete and its failure is RE-complete. For every finite-dimensional channel pair,complete SLD order is equivalent to unrestricted complete Umegaki order over all finite references and all input-state pairs. No total computable function of a valid rational POVM pair bounds a reference dimension sufficient to witness every complete-SLD failure.

requires: Two actual channels on the SAME quantum input; the joint input density matrices and untouched reference are allowed to be correlated. The generic computability classification additionally requires the stated rational-complex strictly positive POVM input class.
A common finite input;finite rational-complex strictly positive POVM descriptions for the computability classification.
For the equivalence,any finite-dimensional channel pair;all finite untouched references,faithful input baseline and traceless Hermitian tangent in SLD order.
provides: An explicit two-channel comparison criterion on output distinguishability with arbitrary finite retained quantum memory, with no equal-reference-marginal restriction or subtraction of the memory entropy. This defines the requested relation; it is not an algorithm deciding it.
A programme-accepted generic-class undecidability premise and RE/coRE classification.
Equivalence with unrestricted complete Umegaki state-pair comparison.
No uniform total computable sufficient failure-reference cutoff from the rational POVM input.
assumptions: Each test is finite-dimensional;dimensions are not bounded uniformly over inputs/tests.
Umegaki comparison permits every input-state pair;there is no equal-reference-marginal restriction.
No hardness conclusion for fixed input dimension,transpose-compatible subclasses,restricted-marginal entropy orders or numerical contraction coefficients.
The source-stated internal dependencies are included in Harjas's standing acceptance. N661 is separate context and is not promoted.
costs: Computable many-one reductions;finite symbolic construction,no efficiency or strategy/witness-acquisition guarantee.
Every failure has some finite witness;the result rules out a uniform computable sufficient dimension bound,not every restricted-case algorithm.
